comment: Per-invoice collection decisions, made on the Revenue → Collections page. An explicit decision here ALWAYS wins over the automatic age rule (qb_accounts.ar_writeoff_after_days), in both directions: mark an old invoice 'collectible' to keep chasing it and keep it out of bad debt, or mark a young one 'uncollectible' to write it off now. Keyed by Stripe invoice id. `decision`: uncollectible | collectible. Invoices with no entry fall back to the age rule.
